What Scale AI sells

  • Scale Data Engine: Training data and annotation (labels added to data so models can learn).
  • Scale GenAI Portfolio: AI applications for work inside businesses.
  • Scale Donovan: AI applications for government users.

Risks and disputes

Dated events

EventDateStatusSources
Scale AI sued Mercor and a former employee over trade secretsScale alleged that a former employee took confidential customer documents when he joined Mercor, which Mercor said it never accessed. The parties settled on confidential terms and the case was dismissed with prejudice in January 2026.Sep 2025LawsuitSettled, dismissed with prejudiceU.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. · TechCrunch
Scale AI cut about 14% of staff and ended work with about 500 contractorsA spokesperson confirmed cuts of 200 full-time roles and about 500 contractors. In a staff memo, interim CEO Jason Droege wrote that Scale had ramped up its generative AI capacity too quickly.Jul 2025Workforce changeConfirmed by companySFGATE · TechCrunch
Contributors sued Scale AI alleging they were misclassified as contractorsLed by McKinney v. Scale AI in San Francisco Superior Court, the suits sought unpaid wages for California contributors. Scale denies the claims, and a $12.5 million settlement awaits a final approval hearing on October 30, 2026.Dec 2024LawsuitSettlement awaiting final approvalSimpluris, settlement administrator · SFGATE · TechCrunch
